answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 26375 Country: India Title: My name is rizwan i have two sons their names are fahad and faisal.im worried very much about them.they have lost interes in studies. they dont listen to me, always tv internet.im also not well, i have back pain and knee joint pain.my husband is suffering from diabetes. plz suggest dua or wazifa for my sons and for my family also for barakah in business. Question: assalamualaikum mufti sahab. my name is rizwan i have two sons their names are fahad and faisal.im worried very much about them.they have lost interes in studies. they dont listen to me, always tv internet.im also not well, i have back pain and knee joint pain.my husband is suffering from diabetes. plz suggest dua or wazifa for my sons and for my family also for barakah in business.. plz reply soon allah hafiz Answer ID: 26375 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1646/1189/L=1431) You should keep away your sons from TV and internet by any means because after being addicted to it your children will turn bad day by day. You should persuade them for salah and fast, and for blessings in the house recite durood at least one thousand times daily along with the recitation of the holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
